messages:
rachel: Found a partner-maintained archive that exposed a bunch of KMS ciphertexts and a tiny manifest referencing our Vault path secret/data/staging/agent. No plaintext but manifest lists svc ids and an old KMS key ARN. Treat as potential exposure and start containment.

sec-bot: Incident filed: INC-20260504-07 · severity=high · assigned=eng-security · link=https://incidents.internal/INC-20260504-07 :rotating_light:

omar: Path and filenames? were objects public?

rachel: s3://partner-data/staging-archives/2026-05-04.tar.gz 
contains: staging/enc_creds.bin, staging/manifest.min.json (manifest includes svc_accounts=[staging-agent, staging-bridge], vault_path=secret/data/staging/agent, prev_kms=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444:key/oldxyz)
Partner says ACL was accidental and now removed. I copied to our quarantine: s3://redwood-quarantine/4790012346/ and set object-lock + 48h TTL.

juno: Immediate containment checklist: 1) snapshot Vault metadata (redacted) and upload to audit bucket with short TTL, 2) enable/expand Vault audit forwarding for that path to SIEM for 90d, 3) provision dedicated rotor KMS key (cross-account safe) and grant rewrap rights only, 4) apply temporary RBAC deny to non-ci-staging principals. I'll flip #1 and #2 now.

vikram: For snapshot we should redact secret fields. Example: 
```
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/staging/agent | jq 'del(.data.data.password, .data.data.token)' > /tmp/staging-meta.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/staging-meta.json s3://redwood-audit-buckets/4790012346.json --sse aws:kms
```
Set lifecycle 24h and restrict ACL to sec-team only.

omar: I'll create alias/kms-rotor-staging-4790 with policy restricting actions to ReEncrypt/Decrypt and allowing only the ops-rewrap-role from our ops VPC and our HSM signer (no general encrypt). Plan: re-encrypt locally and do NOT return the ciphertext to partner. Instead, we will issue fresh, short-lived credentials and require deletion proof. ETA ~30m.

rachel: Also get a list of any Vault accessor IDs that have read the path in the last 90d. Use the audit logs and flag unknown accessors.

juno: Quick audit jq filter I ran earlier (example): 
```
jq 'select(.type=="request" and .data.request.path=="secret/data/staging/agent") | {ts:.time, accessor:.data.auth.accessor, op:.data.request.operation}' /var/log/vault/audit.log
```
I see partner-ci-consumer and two unknown accessors (e4c9a, 7b12d). Forwarded full extracts to SIEM and attached to the incident.

vikram: One nuance: the archive appears to have been created by a partner pipeline that used cross-account KMS wrapping. We'll create the new rotor key in our account and set a single-use grant for rewrap. Also request partner to provide the KMS envelope metadata (their key ids) so we can confirm rewrap mapping.

omar: Rewrap plan CLI: 
```
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://staging/enc_creds.bin --destination-key-id alias/kms-rotor-staging-4790 --source-encryption-context "VaultTransit=true" --output text --query CiphertextBlob | base64 --decode > creds.rewrapped
```
Afterward we will not upload creds.rewrapped to partner. We'll rotate service tokens and revoke old leases.

rachel: RBAC: push a temporary deny via casbin policy (infra PR with immediate rollout): deny read on secret/data/staging/agent for any subject not in role:ci-staging. Keep deny up until creds validated.

juno: Also ask partner security for signed deletion evidence (s3 delete marker + object version + signed attestation). Until we receive it, keep RBAC deny and keep SIEM logging verbose.

vikram: After rewrap: rotate Vault transit key in maintenance, rotate any long-lived service tokens tied to the listed svc accounts, issue short TTL tokens (<=15m), update running tasks, then revoke old leases and remove old accessor entries. We'll rotate IAM keys if any were referenced.

sec-bot: INC-20260504-07 update: responder=omar, quarantine=true, snapshot_uploaded=true, audit_forwarding_enabled=true, kms_key_creation=started

rachel: I'll schedule a 20m partner+oncall sync in 40m to hand over rewrap and require deletion proof. Posting checklist here: quarantine ✔, snapshot ✔, audit-forward ✔, kms grant pending, rewrap in progress, RBAC deny drafted, token rotation pending, partner deletion proof pending, post-incident review TBD. Will update when tokens rotated. :white_check_mark:
